title.zh-CN: 无痛关节肿胀逐年加重

summary.zh-CN: 男孩逐渐出现关节肿胀和活动受限，却缺乏典型炎症症状，需避免直接套用炎症性关节炎诊断。
summary.en: A boy develops progressive swelling and restriction without typical inflammatory symptoms.

provenance.citation: 李小琳, 刘玉玲, 付四毛. 屈曲指－关节炎－髋内翻－心包炎综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(06):471-473. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.06.018.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

answer.zh-CN: 三年前开始发现四肢关节肿胀，逐年加重。
answer.en: Limb joint swelling was noticed three years earlier and worsened each year.

finding.en: Digits other than thumbs and great toes were flexed; elbow and knee motion was restricted with swelling/deformity of elbows, knees, ankles and wrists.

hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

hint.en: Distinguish reported care from the educational plan and review subsequent changes.

prompt.zh-CN: 这些早期资料首先要求怎样调整鉴别？
prompt.en: How should the early evidence reshape the differential?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 优先比较非炎症性关节病与炎症性关节炎
text.en: Compare non-inflammatory arthropathy with inflammatory arthritis

feedback.zh-CN: 持续无痛和反复正常炎症指标使非炎症机制重要。
feedback.en: Persistent painless swelling and repeatedly normal inflammatory markers support considering a non-inflammatory mechanism.

text.zh-CN: 任何多关节肿胀都确诊幼年特发性关节炎
text.en: Any polyarticular swelling proves juvenile idiopathic arthritis

feedback.zh-CN: 形态、炎症证据和其他器官表现均需整合。
feedback.en: Morphology, inflammatory evidence and other organ findings require integration.

text.zh-CN: 化验正常说明关节没有疾病
text.en: Normal tests mean there is no joint disease

feedback.zh-CN: 明显挛缩和影像异常仍是真实疾病证据。
feedback.en: Contractures and imaging abnormalities remain evidence of disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 屈曲指、非炎症性关节病和心包积液构成CACP线索，未达到分子确认
text.en: Camptodactyly, non-inflammatory arthropathy and pericardial effusion suggest CACP without molecular confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: 组合表型支持原报告判断，但不能补写髋测量或PRG4变异。
feedback.en: The combined phenotype supports the report without inventing hip measurements or PRG4 variants.

text.zh-CN: 家族阴性说明已证明新发PRG4突变
text.en: Negative family history proves a de novo PRG4 mutation

feedback.zh-CN: 没有家系分子结果，不能指定遗传机制。
feedback.en: No family molecular data establish that mechanism.

text.zh-CN: 中量积液即等于已发生心包填塞
text.en: Moderate effusion means tamponade is established

feedback.zh-CN: 源中没有填塞的完整临床或超声证据。
feedback.en: Complete clinical or echocardiographic evidence of tamponade is absent.

prompt.zh-CN: 安全的后续计划应包括什么？
prompt.en: What should a safe subsequent plan include?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 遗传与风湿专科复核，功能康复及心包积液监测，避免无证据免疫抑制
text.en: Genetic/rheumatology reassessment, functional rehabilitation and effusion monitoring while avoiding unsupported immunosuppression

feedback.zh-CN: 病因分类影响长期用药，心包风险仍需按实际状态评估。
feedback.en: Aetiological classification affects long-term medication and pericardial risk requires actual clinical assessment.

text.zh-CN: 按炎症性关节炎长期大剂量激素
text.en: Use long-term high-dose steroids as inflammatory arthritis

feedback.zh-CN: 缺乏炎症依据，可能带来无益药物伤害。
feedback.en: Inflammatory evidence is lacking and treatment may cause avoidable harm.

text.zh-CN: 无痛即可忽略挛缩和心包积液
text.en: Ignore contractures and effusion because there is no pain

feedback.zh-CN: 无痛不代表没有功能或心脏风险。
feedback.en: Absence of pain does not remove functional or cardiac risks.

text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界

text.zh-CN: 先明确非炎症性表型并监测心包风险，避免无证据免疫抑制
text.en: Clarify the non-inflammatory phenotype and monitor pericardial risk before unsupported immunosuppression

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明关节肿胀不等于炎症性关节炎。；承认缺乏PRG4检测、明确髋测量和长期功能心脏结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Swelling is not synonymous with inflammatory arthritis.; acknowledge PRG4 testing, explicit hip measurements and long-term functional/cardiac outcomes are lacking. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告临床诊断CACP综合征，分子及完整髋关节确认仍缺失。
conclusion.en: The report made a clinical CACP diagnosis without molecular or complete hip confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 关节肿胀不等于炎症性关节炎。
keyReasoning.en: Swelling is not synonymous with inflammatory arthritis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 屈曲指与心包积液提供跨系统线索。
keyReasoning.en: Camptodactyly and effusion provide multisystem clues.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 遗传标签需要明确证据层级。
keyReasoning.en: Genetic labels require explicit evidence levels.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别无痛、低炎症的模式。

teachingPoints.en: Do not invent undocumented coxa vara.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 临床诊断与分子诊断分开。

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺乏PRG4检测、明确髋测量和长期功能心脏结局。
unknowns.en: PRG4 testing, explicit hip measurements and long-term functional/cardiac outcomes are lacking.
